notes: The article stands on the ordinal rather than on the construct שְׁנַת, and rule 47's rider gives the phrase's single written *the* to that present morpheme, leaving the construct a supplied determiner-free *year*.

The supplied *in* before *the cities of the Medes* was read as the noun's own under rule 33 rather than as a distributed repetition of an earlier בְּ, the two written prepositions in the verse being rendered differently (*in*, *on*).
